notes.subject: Ho na le
notes.rationale: Seheberu se a hlokomela feela — 'ke mokgoa'; Sesotho se hloka ho re 'ho na le'.

notes.subject: maidifu
notes.rationale: חרבות ke bongata ba חרב — 'maidifu'; mongodi o bapisa meno le dihlabelo tsa njara.

notes.subject: חרבות
notes.rationale: ם lemma e bolela kapele 'omiso/kala'; bafetoledi ba bangata ba nkile e le 'maidifu' ka bophara bo (sword-knives).

notes.subject: דור
notes.rationale: Poeletso ya 'mokgoa' ho matsatsi a Agure (30:11-14) — mokgoa o mong le o mong o hlalosa bothata bo bong.

translation: ⟨Ho na le⟩ mokgoa — mano a bona e le maidifu, le dithipa e le ⟨את⟩ meno a bona a ka hare, ho ja ⟨את⟩ batho ba hlokang ho tloha lefatsheng, le ⟨את⟩ ba hlokang ho tloha hara batho.

tokens.gloss: meno a bona a ka hare
